name: papercut
description: Capture the small frictions agents route around silently, then mine them into ranked, tracked fixes. A PostToolUseFailure hook records hard tool failures automatically; a stdlib-only CLI ranks them by how many distinct sessions hit each one, folds related signatures into causal families, and carries one family at a time through an evidence dossier into a filed work item -- with a verification stage that refuses to call a fix verified on silence alone.
